core_model: One finite story trajectory is explored through four persistent temporal slabs. Each slab maintains permissive local beliefs and boundary hypotheses, identifies high-value story questions, and sends them to REHEARSAL. REHEARSAL is the primary semantic execution environment for discovering believable behavior, consequences, relationship movement, implied history, and implied future. STORY SYNC learns conservatively from repeated evidence and updates shared cross-act belief state. Prose is downstream rendering, not the primary coordination format.

persistent_topology.invariant: all four remain persistent and receive a nonzero baseline search heartbeat
persistent_topology.core_rule: invent freely inside an act; promote conservatively across acts

forward_compiler_rule: Given lived behavior and current local reality, extract candidate consequences/opportunities that later temporal slabs should test. Forward consequences are messages, not automatic truth.
backward_compiler_rule: Given a promising later performed state/payoff, extract candidate earlier prerequisites implied by the behavior. Earlier slabs test whether those conditions arise naturally; they do not obey them automatically.

temporal_boundaries.shape: STATE IN -> LOCAL LIVED TRAJECTORY -> STATE OUT
temporal_boundaries.policy: adjacent state-out/state-in disagreements are explicit boundary contradictions; REHEARSAL tests behavioral bridges rather than abstract interpolation

rehearsal_led_execution.anti_rule: do not prescribe emotional or behavioral outcomes unless genuinely locked

heat_levels.probe: cheap plausibility/direction tests and weak-branch rejection
heat_levels.development: compare divergent behavior, discover consequences, connect temporal states
heat_levels.high_heat: major encounters, romance transitions, negotiations, reversals, climaxes, endings, severe cross-act collisions

rehearsal_led_execution.temporal_rehearsal: may rehearse early/middle/late coordinates of one trajectory before intervening prose exists
rehearsal_led_execution.backward_rehearsal: late performance may imply candidate earlier history; emit backward requirements for testing
rehearsal_led_execution.forward_rehearsal: early performance may imply later consequences; emit forward consequences for testing
rehearsal_led_execution.output_policy: reduce routine rehearsal to compact derived evidence; preserve full evidence only when materially useful as case law/provenance

story_sync.role: learning and convergence authority for derived story beliefs
story_sync.merge_policy: preserve viable divergence; sync does not mean merge

creator_taste.role: heuristic for what plausible branches deserve more search/rehearsal; never story authority
creator_taste.state: storage/rebuild layer implemented; search-priority Task 2 contracts exist but current PR full suite is red because runtime integration is not yet complete
creator_taste.counterpressure: creator-surprise keeps at least one plausible non-obvious lane alive during exploration/compare

memory_policy.cold: GitHub durable specs, canon, provenance, important rehearsal case law
memory_policy.warm: shared Story IR / promoted state / compact active act state
memory_policy.hot: task-specific act packet plus current rehearsal pressure and only relevant exact evidence
memory_policy.rule: do not keep every rehearsal transcript or whole repository in hot model context
